Paper Evaluation at a Glance

Paper system

Paper type, end use, furnish and construction.

Addition route

Wet-end, coating or another buyer-defined route.

Optical properties

Brightness, whiteness, colour and opacity, each with its own method.

System observations

Dispersion, agglomeration and retention-related observations in the declared system.

Evidence identity

Document, lot, sample, method and applicable test conditions.

Validation

Laboratory sheet work, more representative trials and finished-paper results remain distinct evidence.

Grades to Review

Review two candidate Grades against your paper system.
